english.title: Use a vehicle without a valid vehicle licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was unlicensed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 29(1) and (3) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used
a vehicle
when vehicle license was not in force

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) See Schedule 2 to the Act for a description of exempt vehicles.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - for wording see end of document.
(iii) See also offence wording: H751 - relating to the keeping of a vehicle on a road.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, used a vehicle namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was unlicensed.

(A)_[The previous licence expired on **(..SPECIFY EXPIRY DATE..).]_
(B)_[The vehicle is unregistered in the UK. The date of entry is unknown.]_
(C)_[The vehicle is unregistered the UK. The date of entry was **(..SPECIFY DATE..).]_

The annual rate of duty at that time was **(..SPECIFY RATE OF DUTY..).

Back duty is claimed in the sum of **(..SPECIFY SUM..) for the period **(..SPECIFY START AND END MONTHS / YEARS..).

other.penalty:
An excise penalty being the greater of either:

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.
or
Five times the amount of duty chargeable in respect of the vehicle.

Where the defendant was the keeper at the time of the offence an additional payment shall be ordered on conviction as specified in section 30(2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 (commonly known as back duty).

Time limit for prosecutions:
36 months
